pages.text: In hot-type biomes, each equipped item gains bonus armor equal to its own armor value × its trait level × 3%. For example, a chestplate with 7 armor and two levels gains 0.42 armor.

With at least four levels across worn armor and held shields, sprint on sand or red sand to switch to third person and take a burrowing pose. Particles appear only at the sand surface. You are invulnerable while burrowing. Hitting a non-sand obstacle makes you surface immediately. Leaving the sand or stopping your sprint also restores normal movement and damage.
